title: Who's Thinking? A Push for Human-Centered Evaluation of LLMs using the XAI Playbook
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research. The paper argues for applying human-centered evaluation principles from XAI to LLMs, focusing on mental models, use case utility, and cognitive engagement.
